description: Delete one of your own discussion entries, if the course allows it. Classmates see that an entry was removed. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

name: delete_my_entry
title: Delete My Entry
